title: One platform bridging the physical and the digital
body: Veranda isn't a single box. It's a stack — locking hardware, modular circuit boards, sensors, wireless communications, and cloud software — that works as one system inside whatever enclosure or access point a partner needs.

layers.title: Enclosure or access point
layers.caption: Porch box, locker, cage, door, or receptacle

capabilities.title: Authorization
capabilities.body: Grant access to exactly the right people, at the right places and times — verified against dispatch or account data rather than a shared code or a copied key.

capabilities.title: Auditability
capabilities.body: Every open, close, and sensor event is recorded: who, when, and — where sensors are fitted — what condition the contents were in.

capabilities.title: Automation
capabilities.body: Schedule recurring access, trigger alerts, and let routine handoffs run without a person waiting at either end.

capabilities.title: Integration
capabilities.body: Embed the lock and board stack in your own enclosure, and connect Veranda's software to the systems your operation already runs.
